title: The latest scheduled Pages deployment passed, but this audit could not inspect its live match rows
detail: At 2026-10-19T04:22:28Z, the GitHub Actions API reported scheduled run 39181195691 on main (created 00:31:58Z, completed 00:39:36Z) as successful. Its listed steps, including Hotspawn collection, unresolved-pick research, probability replay/build, Pages deploy and verify_live, all reported success. GitHub also listed the 11,950,740-byte github-pages artifact. However, downloading the artifact returned EOF after redirecting to its signed archive URL, and the run-log download was likewise unavailable in this session. Therefore this audit does not assert the current live fixture count, any live team probability, or the current unresolved set. The checked-in data/latest.json and data/origination.json are dated 15 October and are fallback fixtures, not current live data. This is an independent-audit access limitation, not evidence that the production run failed; follow the official run and workflow links for manual review.
